scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Ultra Time Patrol Battle encounter evidence
verification_policy: Record encounter sequences from identifiable gameplay evidence without treating one run as proof of every possible variation. Separate observed sequence, reported variation, and unresolved encounter-pool questions.

sources.scope: Full Ultra Time Patrol Battles gameplay with timestamps for seven progression levels and named boss encounters.
Full Ultra Time Patrol Battles gameplay and artwork-reward segment; seven-stage progression is independently visible in the video description.
Official Chapter 4 product description; confirms one new high-difficulty Ultra Time Patrol Battles quest featuring numerous classic characters.
Official Xbox Chapter 4 product listing; confirms Ultra Time Patrol Battles as the single new high-difficulty quest and the broader Chapter 4 content counts.
Official Chapter 4 announcement confirming Ultra Time Patrol Battles and the Gallery of Time.

encounter_research_leads.finding: Two gameplay sources expose a seven-stage progression ending with Fu (Ultra Supervillain) and Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled).
encounter_research_leads.scope_limit: This establishes an observed run structure, not the complete encounter pool or a guarantee that every run uses the same seven stages.

encounter_research_leads.finding: Earlier community testing described three rounds containing three battles each.
encounter_research_leads.reconciliation: The claim is retained rather than discarded because it may use different terminology for internal encounters, but it is not merged with the seven-stage observation until the relationship between rounds, stages, and individual battles is directly established.

encounter_research_leads.finding: Current evidence does not establish whether a numbered gameplay 'stage' is equivalent to a round, contains multiple internal battles, or represents a larger encounter bundle.

reconciled_structure.earlier_nine_battle_claim: A prior community report described three rounds of three battles, while concrete gameplay evidence located here exposes seven numbered progression stages.
reconciled_structure.current_best_description: The wiki should currently describe UTPB as a multi-stage high-difficulty quest and separately record the observed seven-stage run. It should not publish either seven total battles or nine total battles as a definitive universal structure.
reconciled_structure.important_note: Official product listings establish the existence of the high-difficulty quest but do not publish the internal encounter count or branching structure.

reward_observation.artwork_reward_segment: A gameplay source explicitly includes an artwork-reward segment after the seven-stage run.
reward_observation.super_rank_requirement: not established by this encounter evidence layer

research_search_result.finding: Current web search located official Chapter 4 descriptions and additional general coverage, but did not locate sufficiently detailed independent full-run evidence to promote the seven-stage sequence to a universal encounter table.
research_search_result.action: Keep the seven-stage sequence as observed gameplay evidence and preserve the conflicting nine-battle community report as a separate research lead.

important_nonclaims: A single observed run does not establish the complete encounter pool.
No stage is declared mandatory across all runs solely from one gameplay recording.
No enemy order is inferred for runs that may use alternate encounters.
The earlier nine-battle community description is retained as a separate lead rather than overwritten by the seven-stage gameplay evidence.
No artwork identity, item ID, drop rate, or exact reward condition is inferred from the presence of an artwork-reward segment.
Official DLC listings do not establish the internal number of battles or the exact relationship between rounds and stages.
research_targets: Inspect additional complete runs to determine whether stages 1-7 are fixed or selected from pools.
Determine whether the observed boss groups represent stages, rounds, or internal encounter bundles.
Reconcile the seven-stage gameplay evidence with the earlier three-round/nine-battle community report.
Map each stage to its boost-selection checkpoint and resource-reset behavior.
Identify the artwork shown in the reward segment and determine its exact acquisition rule.
Build an encounter matrix from multiple independent runs before assigning mandatory/variable status to individual opponents.
